query: INSERT INTO weekly_scores (id, user_id, week_start, season_id, rule_set_version, progress_c, consistency_c, performance_c, challenge_c, total, breakdown, lp_transaction_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE season_id = VALUES(season_id), rule_set_version = VALUES(rule_set_version), progress_c = VALUES(progress_c), consistency_c = VALUES(consistency_c), performance_c = VALUES(performance_c), challenge_c = VALUES(challenge_c), total = VALUES(total), breakdown = VALUES(breakdown), lp_transaction_id = VALUES(lp_transaction_id)
